reasoning: Mixed signals. POSITIVES: Clear pain points exist (communication chaos, documentation issues, budget tracking), highly fragmented market (1M+ companies), zero localized residential SMB solutions, excellent unit economics (6.4x LTV:CAC, 7.5mo payback). NEGATIVES: Very low current software adoption among Polish SME builders (Excel/manual dominant), high price sensitivity requires $200-350/month vs Buildertrend's $299-799, user resistance to change. Need pilot with 10-15 builders to validate willingness to pay before full build.
